13:40.race_name: Racing To School Celebrates 25 Years Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners.comment: Scored by 7.5l under positive ride here (2m) last month; upped in trip today
runners.name: Crest Of Stars
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner; lacked fluency when beaten favourite on hurdling debut in December but made amends with 7.5l success under positive ride here (2m, good) last month; big player if suited by the increased emphasis on stamina today.

runners.comment: Created good impression when winning by 12l at Ayr last month; leading contender
runners.name: Kings Champion
runners.spotlight: Caught the eye when keeping on steadily for third on seasonal/hurdle debut in November and created good impression when drawing clear to win by 12l at Ayr (2m4f, soft) last month; ought to be a tough nut to crack.

runners.comment: Out of a well-connected bumper winner; has fairly useful standard to reach on debut
runners.name: Angel Wave
runners.spotlight: Third foal; dam bumper winner/placed in 2m-2m4f hurdles, half-sister to winners useful jumpers Blue Las and Angels Antics; makes some appeal on paper but has fairly useful standard to reach on debut.

runners.comment: Began hurdling career with two encouraging runs but needs significant improvement today
runners.name: Bye Bye Salam
runners.owner: D Smith & Hudson Plumbing And Heating
runners.spotlight: Nothing special on the Flat but began hurdling career with two quite encouraging runs in December, more recently when staying on for never-dangerous third over C&D (good; ride attracted stewards' attention); has quite a bit to find with the principals today, though, and is not sure to be suited by the slower ground.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten at triple-digit odds on first two hurdling starts
runners.name: Hannibal Bogan
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten at triple-digit odds on first two hurdling starts, the latter over 2m here (good) in December.

runners.comment: Irish point second last May but yet to show anything more than minor promise under rules
runners.name: Kings Order
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in good-ground Irish point last spring but yet to show anything more than minor promise under rules.

runners.comment: Always behind when 200-1 for Exeter maiden hurdle last month
runners.name: Like A Dancer
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far when sixth on bumper debut in October but always behind when 200-1 for Exeter maiden hurdle (2m, good to soft) last month.

runners.comment: Out of form on the Flat last year and soundly beaten over 2m here on both hurdling starts
runners.name: Marhaba Million
runners.spotlight: Badly out of form on the Flat for Anthony Charlton last year and soundly beaten at triple-digit odds in two 2m hurdles here (both on good) for new stable; cheekpieces left off today.

runners.comment: Fourth in valuable Newbury bumper last March; makes hurdle debut after 318-day layoff
runners.name: Talk To The Man
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner (good to yielding) who bettered his low-key rules debut when fourth in valuable Newbury bumper (good) last March; makes hurdling debut after 318-day absence and on much slower ground but looks an interesting prospect.

14:12.race_name: Racing To School Celebrates 25 Years Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners.comment: Won at Stratford on second hurdle run; this looks a winnable assignment under 7lb penalty
runners.name: Wandering Ego
runners.spotlight: Won at Stratford (2m, good to soft) in October on second hurdle start; similar form in defeat since in warm novice hurdle at Kempton (2m, good) and handicap at Kempton (2m, good); up in trip on different ground but showed promise in a 3m point on heavy; leading form claims under a 7lb penalty.

runners.breeder: S C E A De Maulepaire Et Al
runners.comment: Tailed off on debut but has smart pedigree; interesting to see how he goes in the betting
runners.name: Brisky Dancer
runners.spotlight: 4-1 when tailed off in a tongue-tie (retained) on debut at Chepstow (2m3f, good to soft) in December; not easy to fancy on the back of that but this £165,000 purchase has a smart pedigree and should be capable of considerably better at some point; interesting to see how he goes in the betting.

runners.comment: Showed some ability in sole bumper but pulled up/tailed off on first two hurdle starts
runners.name: Crest Of Valour
runners.spotlight: Showed some ability in sole bumper but pulled up/tailed off on first two hurdle starts and a transformation is needed.

runners.comment: Down the field on all four starts, most recently when 150-1 at Southwell yesterday
runners.name: Dino Moon
runners.spotlight: Down the field on all four starts, most recently when 150-1 at Southwell yesterday.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten at big odds on his two completed hurdle starts
runners.name: Dragons And Demons
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten at big odds on his two completed hurdle starts (2m/1m7f, good to soft/soft) and others make greater appeal.

runners.comment: Signs of inexperience when runner-up on debut and he's in good hands to progress; player
runners.name: Grand Vendetta
runners.spotlight: Signs of inexperience when second of 11, beaten just over 8l, on debut at Chepstow in December (2m3f, good to soft; 5-2); this 140,000euros purchase has a useful pedigree and is in good hands to progress, with his trainer possessing a good record in this race; firmly in calculations.

runners.comment: Sixth of 14 on sole Flat start which was back in May 2023; probably best watched
runners.name: Inkaman
runners.spotlight: His dam was useful on the Flat and this 6yo showed some ability for Alan King in May 2023 on his sole Flat start; however, absent since (wind/gelding operations in interim) and he's probably best watched on his hurdle and stable debut; wears a first-time tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Bumper winner; place claims on fourth hurdle start but needs something extra to win
runners.name: Joyau Allen
runners.spotlight: Heavy-ground bumper winner who took a step forward when eighth of 13 over C&D (good to soft) last month on his third hurdle start; this race isn't so deep and he's a place contender, but he needs something extra if he's to come out on top.

runners.breeder: David Jamison Bloodstock And G Roddick
runners.comment: 11yo who has shown signs of ability but this is his first run since September 2022
runners.name: Lunchable Bob
runners.spotlight: Displayed signs of ability in bumpers and also on hurdle debut in September 2022; however, this 11yo has been absent since and a watching brief is probably the best option on his return to action.

14:45.race_name: 9 March Dragonbet Festival Fever Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Herring Queen Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Returned to form to win Wincanton handicap on yard debut; leading claims if backing it up
runners.name: Queenie St Clair
runners.spotlight: Returned to form to win a handicap at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft) on Boxing Day on stable debut, after a break; her Flat win came on testing ground; leading claims under 6lb penalty if backing up latest effort.

runners.comment: Runner-up over C&D last month on second hurdle start and she holds solid claims
runners.name: Beauty In The Park
runners.spotlight: Built upon her bumper promise (including on heavy ground) when going close over C&D last month on her second hurdle start (good to soft; led); open to further improvement and she holds solid claims.

runners.comment: Tailed off at 40-1 on last month's debut at Fontwell (2m1f, soft)
runners.name: Casts Georgie
runners.owner: Sue & Clive Cole & Ann & Tony Gale
runners.spotlight: Dam was a useful dual-purpose performer but this 5yo was tailed off at 40-1 on last month's debut at Fontwell (2m1f, soft).

runners.comment: 14l third at Fontwell on recent rules debut; others have more substance to their form
runners.name: Geordies Betty
runners.spotlight: Third of six in point-to-point bumper and filled same position in novice hurdle at Fontwell (2m1f, soft) on recent rules debut; that run gives her something to build on but others have more substance to their form.

runners.comment: With a good stable but she was well beaten on her debut in a bumper at Uttoxeter
runners.name: Loro White
runners.spotlight: It's very early days and she's with a good stable; however, she was well beaten on her debut in a bumper at Uttoxeter on New Year's Eve (2m, good to soft; 9-1) and has to leave that form well behind on hurdle debut.

runners.comment: Point runner-up; didn't run badly against males on h'dle debut; might have each-way chance
runners.name: Shanagolden Girl
runners.spotlight: Down the field on both rules starts but this point runner-up (3m, good) didn't run badly against males on recent hurdle debut here (2m3f, good to soft), and she might have an each-way chance if taking a step forward.

runners.comment: Fourth on all four starts, most recently against males at Newbury; might not be far away
runners.name: Yeld To Call
runners.spotlight: She's finished fourth on all four starts, most recently against males at Newbury (2m, good to soft) on her second hurdle start; back against mares today and might not be far away.

runners.comment: Won twice towards end of last season, and might have needed his reappearance run
runners.name: Imaginarium
runners.spotlight: Came good for Olly Murphy with two wins (both on good to soft) towards end of last season; finished last on last month's reappearance outing, having dropped out tamely in the straight, but might have needed that run and further progress remains possible if he copes with the ground here.

runners.comment: Very lightly raced since his two novice wins in 2022-23; current ability hard to gauge
runners.name: Doyen Star
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 8yo who launched rules career with two novice hurdle wins in 2022-23 season but disappointed in both chases during following campaign and, after a long absence, was soundly beaten on handicap hurdle debut in November; current ability hard to gauge.

runners.comment: Ran well on good ground at Kempton last month but conditions are a concern here
runners.name: Courageous Strike
runners.spotlight: Fairly useful Flat racer with 2-6 strike-rate over hurdles; gave good account when third of eight at Kempton (2m, good) last month and is probably still on a workable mark but has something to prove on the much slower ground here.

runners.comment: Not disgraced at Wincanton last month but has basically become disappointing
runners.name: Teorie
runners.spotlight: Not disgraced when fifth at Wincanton (2m4f, soft) last month and continues to slip down the weights but has basically become a bit disappointing; needs to up his game.

runners.comment: Two good runs in blinkers this season, latterly when clear second of 13 at Wincanton
runners.name: Phoenix Risen
runners.spotlight: Two good runs in blinkers this season, latterly when clear second of 13 at Wincanton (1m7f, soft; unraced on heavy) in December; nudged back up to his career-high mark since but still commands respect.

runners.comment: Placed at Newbury since C&D win in December but may prefer better ground than this
runners.name: Premier
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat racer who opened hurdles account over C&D (good) in December, his fourth attempt, and might well have bettered that performance when close third at Newbury (2m, good to soft) last month; could still have more to offer but the slower ground here may not be ideal.

runners.comment: Finished tired when fifth at Ffos Las last month and is 6lb wrong here
runners.name: Daany
runners.owner: Duckhaven D Kenealy W Sprigg M Sprigg
runners.spotlight: Won four times over hurdles in 2024 (good-heavy) but finished tired after running well for a long way at Ffos Las (2m, heavy) last month and is effectively 4lb higher from out of the weights here.

15:45.race_name: Arthur & Peggy White Memorial Handicap Chase (Challenger Staying Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Lightly raced 10yo; disappointed on seasonal debut and needs to get career back on track
runners.name: Brave Kingdom
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 10yo who disappointed on seasonal debut in November (first run after latest of three wind ops) and has now been pulled up on three of his last four appearances; eased in grade today but needs to get career back on track.

runners.comment: Largely in good form over shorter trips this season; contender if stamina holds out
runners.name: Royal Jewel
runners.spotlight: Returned from layoff with two good runs (one win) over 2m5f in the autumn and bounced back quickly from a lesser effort when third at Chepstow (2m3f, good to soft) just after Christmas; not yet proven over this far under rules but seems versatile ground-wise and can make his presence felt.

runners.comment: 3-5 since cheekpieces were added last year; probably worth another crack at a staying trip
runners.name: Good Friday Fairy
runners.spotlight: Progressive since cheekpieces were added just under a year ago, winning three times (2m3f-2m5f, good to soft/soft); kept on well for third off today's mark at Exeter (2m3f, good to soft) last month and is probably worth another crack at a staying trip; good chance.

runners.comment: Back on a good mark but has not really fired on either appearance this season
runners.name: Bucksy Des Epeires
runners.spotlight: Back on a good mark now but ended last season on a low note and has not really fired on either appearance this term (favourite both times); comes here with a bit to prove, including stamina.

runners.breeder: Mrs Larissa Kneip & Mrs Sandrine Grevet
runners.comment: Back in prime form two starts ago but pulled up since and has become hard to predict
runners.name: Captain Boudet
runners.spotlight: Won twice last season (2m5f/2m3f); back in prime form when clear second at Hereford (3m1f, good to soft; also suited by soft) in December, his second start this term, and remains unexposed as a stayer but ran poorly at Newbury last month and has become hard to predict.

16:15.race_name: 24 March Behind The Scenes Raceday Novices' Handicap Chase

runners.breeder: David Lumet & Dr V Catherine Lumet
runners.comment: Gave good account when close third at Ludlow last month and seems versatile ground-wise
runners.name: Jaitroplaclasse
runners.spotlight: Just 1-11 over fences but gave good account when close third in first-time cheekpieces at Ludlow (2m4f, good to soft) last month and should be fine on the slower ground here; one to consider.

runners.comment: Well held on seasonal/chase debut in November but may yet come good for Venetia Williams
runners.name: Falco Des Pins
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 6yo; unplaced all five British starts, most recently when well-held sixth on seasonal/chase debut in November, but was given a wind op in December and may yet come good for Venetia Williams.

runners.comment: In the frame all three hurdle starts this season; faced tough task on recent chase debut
runners.name: Storming Nelson
runners.spotlight: Just 1-13 over hurdles but has arrested his decline and made the frame in three handicaps this season (2m-2m5f); copes well with heavy ground and will find this race much easier than useful Chepstow novice he contested on last week's chasing debut; no surprise if he features.

runners.comment: Below form over hurdles last time but runner-up twice over fences in November; headgear on
runners.name: Nedzor
runners.spotlight: Disappointing favourite when back over hurdles last month but came second in two soft-ground chases in November (2m/2m4f) and will be on the premises if quickly back on song in first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Dual hurdle winner; yet to strike form this season; cheekpieces added for chase debut
runners.name: Just Aidan
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner (once on heavy ground) in early part of last year but yet to strike form after two starts this term; needs good boost from first-time cheekpieces on this chasing debut.

runners.comment: Tailed off here on last month's chasing debut and now 0-8 overall
runners.name: Holy Legend
runners.spotlight: Tailed off here (2m, good to soft) on last month's chasing debut and now 0-8 overall; might have needed that outing (his first since July) but others in the line-up have more obvious claims.

runners.comment: First past the post in this race a year ago and now 2lb lower; high on the list
runners.name: Palawan Du Mazet
runners.spotlight: Won this race readily (soft ground) on chasing debut at year ago, only to be disqualified after testing positive for a banned substance; made low-key reappearance on good ground here in December but still features prominently in calculations.

runners.comment: Showed nothing more than glimmers of promise during eight-run hurdling career; chase debut
runners.name: Joker Jack
runners.spotlight: Showed nothing more than glimmers of promise during eight-race hurdling career (2m-3m) and is 3lb out of the weights for this chasing debut; difficult to enthuse over.

runners.comment: Placed on heavy ground since good-ground win in November; respected in current mood
runners.name: Our Dylan
runners.spotlight: Bounced back to form to win 14-runner Wincanton handicap (2m4f, good) in November and again ran well when third at Ffos as (2m4f, heavy) last month; remains on career-high mark but must be considered in current mood.

runners.comment: Soundly beaten three times since returning from long absence for new stable in October
runners.name: Road Senam
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten on all three starts (2m5f-3m) since returning from long absence for new stable in October; sure to appreciate this ease in grade but has a lot to prove.

runners.comment: Showed benefit of a wind op when running well for a long way at Leicester last month
runners.name: Ilot de LIsle
runners.spotlight: Bumper/hurdle winner in France in autumn 2022; pulled up in two British handicap hurdles last year but, following a wind op, ran well for a long way when fifth at Leicester (1m7f, heavy; first-time cheekpieces) a fortnight ago; back up in trip with tongue-tie refitted today; a possible.

runners.comment: Didn't get home over 3m here last time but Paul Nicholls may yet find the key to him
runners.name: Its A Breeze
runners.spotlight: Didn't get home after racing too freely here (3m, good to soft) last month and is now 0-6 over hurdles but significant positives can still be taken from that latest run, and Paul Nicholls may yet find the key to him; drops back in trip with tongue-tie added today.

runners.comment: Travelled strongly for a long way when placed on handicap debut at Wincanton on Thursday
runners.name: Ourbrowneyedgirl
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 7yo who travelled strongly for a long way when third of 11 on handicap debut at Wincanton (2m4f, heavy) on Thursday; big player if in similar form here.

runners.comment: Ran okay over C&D last month but the forecast slower ground is a big worry today
runners.name: Taritino
runners.spotlight: Won on fast ground here (2m) last spring and stayed on for respectable fifth over C&D (good to soft) last month but the forecast heavy ground is a big worry today.

runners.comment: C&D winner last season but well beaten both starts this term and has ground worries today
runners.name: Whatmakes Honey B
runners.spotlight: Now only 1lb higher than when winning over C&D (good) on handicap debut last March but both runs this season have been disappointing and she was withdrawn from latest engagement with heavy ground deemed unsuitable.

runners.comment: Three-time Flat winner but 0-6 over hurdles; others have much stronger claims
runners.name: Ask Peter
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner (good to soft-heavy) but 0-6 over hurdles; not beaten far when third of four in mares' novice at Ludlow (2m5f, good) in October but that race was very slowly run; others have much stronger claims.

runners.comment: Absent since Stratford third last March but Sean Bowen is booked again
runners.name: Dish Of The Day
runners.spotlight: 0-7 over hurdles; absent since placed in first-time cheekpieces at Stratford (2m2f, good to soft) last March and not sure to be suited by the slower ground here but it's interesting that Sean Bowen is booked again.

runners.comment: Out of sorts for new stable since the autumn; leap of faith required to support him
runners.name: Bossofthebus
runners.spotlight: Won Clonmel handicap (2m4f, soft) just over a year ago but has looked out of sorts on all four hurdle/chase starts for new stable since the autumn, and it takes a leap of faith to support him here.

13:30.race_name: Racing TV Novices' Hurdle (Novices' Championship Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Well beaten in two bumpers and pulled up on hurdles debut; best watched for now
runners.name: Blazing Echo
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers and pulled up on hurdles debut; best watched for now.

runners.comment: Modest Flat performer; one promising race over hurdles; better opportunities in handicaps
runners.name: Delayed Charm
runners.spotlight: Modest performer on the Flat; has run one promising race over hurdles, but will find better opportunities in handicaps.

runners.comment: Irish point winner; cost £30,000 but well beaten in a bumper on rules debut; more needed
runners.name: Double Indemnity
runners.spotlight: Bought for £30,000 after winning an Irish point in November (3m, yielding); 25-1 when sixth of eight in an Aintree bumper on rules debut in December; improvement needed now going hurdling.

runners.comment: Form of his Chepstow bumper win is rock solid; good second on hurdles debut; contender
runners.name: Its Top
runners.spotlight: Won a point bumper in April 2024 and a Chepstow bumper on rules debut in November 2024 (2m, good to soft; form solid); made a promising hurdles debut on return from 327-day break when 13l second to a 2-13 shot at Newbury last month (2m, good to soft; first run after wind surgery); contender.

runners.comment: Irish point winner who cost 25,000euros; pulled up on hurdles debut (100-1); best watched
runners.name: Jonzac
runners.spotlight: Won an Irish point in November; sold for 25,000euros the following month; pulled up in a Uttoxeter maiden hurdle on rules debut (100-1) and best watched for now.

runners.comment: Irish point second; shaped quite well in two runs for new yard but improvement needed
runners.name: Karma De Cotte
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point in October; has shaped quite well in his two runs for new yard, but needs to improve to take this.

runners.breeder: E A R L Les Obeaux DAnjou Et Al
runners.comment: Second in an Irish point; good 2nd on hurdles debut; not so good last time but a possible
runners.name: Lasko Des Obeaux
runners.spotlight: Irish point second (3m, yielding to soft); placed on both starts over hurdles, better effort when runner-up at Chepstow on debut (2m, soft); not so good on heavy going at Exeter last time; contender.

runners.comment: Second in an Irish point; two fair runs over hurdles; likely to fare better in handicaps
runners.name: Party In The Park
runners.spotlight: Irish point second (3m, good); two fair runs over hurdles but likely to be seen to better advantage when going handicapping; tongue-tie fitted.

runners.comment: Only modest form over hurdles, latest run after a 598-day break; best watched this time
runners.name: Road To Rosley
runners.spotlight: Only modest form over hurdles, latest run after a 598-day break; best watched this time.

runners.comment: Fair third in a bumper but well beaten on hurdles debut last time; improvement likely
runners.name: Swingforthefence
runners.spotlight: Fair third of five on bumper debut in March (2m1f, good) but was a well-beaten 40-1 shot on his hurdles debut at Newcastle last month; may fare better this time.

runners.comment: Modest efforts in an Ayr bumper and in two runs over hurdles; others preferred
runners.name: Takeyoutotheisland
runners.spotlight: Modest efforts in an Ayr bumper and in two runs over hurdles; others preferred.

runners.comment: Close second to subsequent winner on bumper debut; very interesting now hurdling
runners.name: Thorneylands
runners.spotlight: Gelding by Getaway; ran a very promising race when second to a subsequent easy winner in a Newcastle bumper on his debut in December (2m1f, good to soft; 13-8 favourite); half-brother to a useful 2m1f hurdler, so very interesting now going over hurdles for the first time.

runners.comment: Jumping issues on last two starts but he's a major player on his previous chase form
runners.name: First Confession
runners.spotlight: The only one of these with chasing experience; didn't jump well when soundly beaten at Cheltenham in December and fell at Exeter latest; however, before those he ran well to finish third over C&D (good to soft) and at Kempton (3m, good) in his first two chases; major player if he's on song.

runners.comment: Point/maiden h'dle winner; something to find in this company even if he's back to his best
runners.name: Scarlet Jet
runners.spotlight: Comfortably won maiden hurdle at Perth (2m4f, good to soft) last April; this point winner could be suited by the switch to fences but he's been soundly beaten in two novice hurdles this season and has something to find in today's company even if he's back to his best.

runners.comment: Makes chase debut after some time off but he can go well fresh and dam was a smart chaser
runners.name: Thank You Maam
runners.owner: The Posh Pundit Racing Club Limited
runners.spotlight: Two-time hurdle winner (2m7f/3m, good to soft/good) who raced prominently in that sphere; makes chase debut after some time off but he's run well when fresh previously and his dam was a smart chaser; brings potential to this first run over fences and this trip at a stiff track should suit him.

runners.comment: Talented mare who holds leading claims if taking to fences at the first attempt
runners.name: Della Casa Lunga
runners.spotlight: Three front-running hurdle wins in 2024 (2m5f/3m, soft/good to soft) and she was running pretty well in defeat against fellow mares towards the end of 2025; receives 7lb from the males today and holds leading claims if taking to fences at the first attempt.

14:35.race_name: British Stallion Studs EBF Mares' "National Hunt" Novices' Hurdle (EBF Mares' NH Nov' Qual') (GBB)

runners.comment: Won on hurdle debut at Windsor then weakened over 2m6f on heavy; could play a leading role
runners.name: Future Bucks
runners.spotlight: Ex-French 5yo who won on British debut at Windsor (2m, good to soft) in November; weakened when well-beaten third at Uttoxeter (2m6f, heavy) since and could play a leading role under a penalty now back down in trip.

runners.comment: Sprung 125-1 shock on reappearance at Perth in October but hasn't kicked on since
runners.name: Just An Artist
runners.spotlight: Sprung 125-1 shock on reappearance at Perth (2m, soft) in October; however, she hasn't kicked on from that win in her two outings since and may again be vulnerable this afternoon.

runners.comment: Won at Lingfield in December and useful pedigree provides hope she'll continue to progress
runners.name: Oh Clare
runners.spotlight: Promising second on hurdle/seasonal debut here (2m1f, soft) in November and improved for the step up in trip to win at Lingfield (2m3f, good to soft) in December, despite her inexperience being evident; useful pedigree provides optimism she'll continue to progress; likely player under a 7lb penalty.

runners.comment: Well beaten in all three bumpers and pulled up at 300-1 on hurdle debut at Ayr last week
runners.name: Am I Bovvered
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in all three bumpers and pulled up at 300-1 on hurdle debut at Ayr (2m, soft) last Thursday; she'd be a shock winner.

runners.comment: The step up in trip could help but she was soundly beaten at 50-1 on debut in bumper here
runners.name: Bollin Skittle
runners.spotlight: Pedigree suggests the step up in trip will be a positive on hurdle debut but she was soundly beaten at 50-1 on her debut in a bumper here (2m1f, soft) in December and may be best watched for now.

runners.comment: Runner-up on debut at Uttoxeter in November & attractive pedigree suggests she'll improve
runners.name: Rosie Mahler
runners.spotlight: 11-2 when second of seven on debut in maiden hurdle at Uttoxeter (2m4f, heavy) in November; that form isn't overly strong but gives her something to build and her attractive pedigree suggests she'll improve; contender.

runners.comment: Second to Oh Clare on hurdle debut and open to improvement; she's one to consider
runners.name: Sevarana
runners.spotlight: Good-ground bumper winner who was beaten just over 3l by Oh Clare (now penalised) when runner-up on hurdle debut at Lingfield (2m3f, good to soft) in December, following a break; open to improvement and she's one to consider.

runners.comment: Big odds and well beaten in seventh in all three bumpers; now goes hurdling
runners.name: Strathcatcha
runners.owner: M Waterton D Amos G Rutherford
runners.spotlight: Big odds and well beaten in seventh in all three bumpers; a transformation is necessary on this first hurdle start.

15:05.race_name: Racing TV Mares' Handicap Chase (Challenger Mares' Chase Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Ran okay in face of tough task at Newbury; capable of having a big say now back in a h'cap
runners.name: Ilovethenightlife
runners.spotlight: Just one win from her 11 chase starts and inconsistent this season but she ran okay in the face of a tough task when third of five in Listed race at Newbury (2m7f, good to soft) three weeks ago; capable of having a big say now back in a handicap.

runners.comment: Won in first-time blinkers at Perth last April when last seen; has gone well fresh
runners.name: Lady In The Park
runners.spotlight: With these blinkers applied she jumped well and showed improved form to win when back over fences at Perth (3m, good to soft) last April; absent since but she's gone well fresh in the past and could have more to offer in the retained headgear; major player if she's at the top of her game.

runners.comment: Her reduced mark, drop back in trip and first-time cheekpieces could all be positives
runners.name: Sunset Hill
runners.spotlight: 0-5 over fences but this is her first chase start against fellow mares; she's faded over 3m1f/2m7f on her last two starts and her reduced mark, drop back in trip and first-time cheekpieces could all be positives; chance.

runners.comment: Easy wins on two of her last three starts; could still be ahead of the handicapper
runners.name: Celestial Fashion
runners.spotlight: Won by 10l on reappearance here (2m4f, soft) in November and, after not staying 3m at Ayr, she bounced back with an easy, all-the-way win at Wetherby (2m3f, soft) 12 days ago; 8lb higher in a tougher race today but this progressive 8yo could still be ahead of the handicapper.

runners.comment: Good third in this last year; encouraging run last time; contender now back down in trip
runners.name: Similar Story
runners.spotlight: Disappointing in the main this season but took step back in the right direction when fifth at Sedgefield (3m2f, good to soft) nine days ago, when she ran well for a long way in first-time cheekpieces before fading; now 6lb lower than when good third in this race last year (soft) and could play a leading role now back down in trip; reapplied tongue-tie joins cheekpieces.

runners.comment: 10lb out of the handicap but this C&D winner was in good form in the autumn when last seen
runners.name: Divas Doyen
runners.spotlight: C&D winner who was in good form in the autumn, finishing second at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) in November when last seen, behind one who has followed up; 10lb out of the handicap today but might not be far away.

15:35.race_name: Watch Racing TV Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Two Mile Hurdle Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: 5-8 over hurdles, latest win on h'cap debut in December; good second last time; player
runners.name: Smart Decision
runners.spotlight: Has won five of his eight races over hurdles, the latest on handicap debut off 7lb lower at Market Rasen in December (2m2f, good to soft); close second at Haydock last time (1m7f, good to soft); up another 2lb but should go well again.

runners.comment: Won 2m4f mares' handicap at Musselburgh last time; this harder but has an each-way chance
runners.name: Kientzheim
runners.spotlight: Off the mark for the season in a 2m4f mares' handicap at Musselburgh last time (good to soft); this looks harder, but has an each-way chance.

runners.comment: Ex-Gavin Cromwell; maiden hurdle win in July and two fair runs since; stable debut
runners.name: Dunkerque
runners.spotlight: Won a maiden hurdle for Gavin Cromwell in July (2m1f, good); two fair runs in handicaps since; quite interesting on stable debut after a break.

runners.comment: Two wins for Micky Hammond, the latest over C&D; up 7lb; should go well on stable debut
runners.name: Medieval Gold
runners.spotlight: Two wins for Micky Hammond, the latest a C&D handicap in November (soft; beat That One by 5.5l); progressive sort who should go well on stable debut despite 7lb rise; tongue-tie on for the first time.

runners.comment: Second to Medieval Gold over C&D last time; may turn the tables on these better terms
runners.name: That One
runners.spotlight: Progressive; two wins last year and a good 5.5l second to Medieval Gold when back after a break in a C&D handicap in November (2m1f, soft); chance of turning the tables on 6lb better terms.

runners.comment: Won fourth race over hurdles last time and should go well again despite career-high mark
runners.name: Haarar
runners.spotlight: Won his fourth race over hurdles when scoring over 2m3f at Haydock in December (good to soft); stable in fine form, so should go well again despite a career-high mark.

runners.comment: Fortunate maiden win last time, but is a progressive mare who could go well on h'cap debut
runners.name: Gintime
runners.spotlight: Probably a lucky winner of a four-runner novice at Sedgefield last time (2m1f, good to soft) but is an unexposed sort who could go well on handicap debut.

runners.comment: Course winner; not been at his best this term; probably best watched in a strong race
runners.name: Raffertys Return
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner, including over 2m3f here; hasn't been at his best in two runs this season and probably best watched in what looks a competitive event.

runners.comment: Won three over C&D on good to soft last term; fair run latest but improvement needed
runners.name: Lady Babs
runners.spotlight: Has a fine record here (three C&D wins on good to soft last year); improved on her reappearance run when fifth at Market Rasen last time but more needed.

runners.comment: Fair form but no win for this yard; well beaten when last seen out. tongue-tie back on
runners.name: Book Of Secrets
runners.spotlight: Some fair form without winning for this yard; wasn't at his best when seventh over C&D in November when last seen out; tongue-tie now back on; others appeal more.

runners.comment: 2m2f Kelso win for Rebecca Menzies last May; well beaten on stable debut; best watched
runners.name: Spartan Warrior
runners.spotlight: Won at Kelso last May (2m2f, good) when with Rebecca Menzies; well beaten on stable debut last time and perhaps best watched for now.

16:04.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap Chase (Go North Red Rum Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Lightly raced bumper and two-time maiden hurdle runner-up who is not written off
runners.name: Orkney Blue
runners.spotlight: Flopped at Hexham in December on second chase start and something to prove on the back of that; however, this lightly raced bumper and two-time maiden hurdle runner-up wasn't devoid of promise when sixth on his chase/handicap debut at Kelso (2m7f, soft) in November and is not written off.

runners.comment: Bolted up at Ayr in December; well beaten there since but made a bad mistake six out
runners.name: Wholly Boley
runners.spotlight: Bolted up at Ayr (3m, heavy) in December on third chase start; well beaten back there last month but made a bad mistake six out; he'll be in the picture if rediscovering the form of his December win.

runners.comment: Inconsistent 12yo but 2-2 here and he's firmly in calculations now back here
runners.name: Super Citizen
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent 12yo who was well beaten at Kelso last time; however, two visits to Carlisle have yielded two wins (3m/3m2f, good/soft), the latest in November; firmly in calculations now back here.

runners.comment: Runner-up on last month's chase debut and he's one to consider on first run for new yard
runners.name: Shadow Chaser
runners.spotlight: Point winner who was no match for Uptown Harry but still ran well when runner-up in first-time blinkers on his chase debut at Newcastle (2m7f, good to soft) last month; has since left Sandy Thomson; open to improvement in this sphere and he's one to consider now starting out for Mark Walford.

runners.comment: Encouraging run over hurdles last month; a handy mark and the longer trip are positives
runners.name: Raceview Road
runners.spotlight: Lost his way over fences last season but he kept on for an encouraging fourth of 19 over hurdles at Ayr (2m4f, soft) last month and has a handy mark to work with now back chasing, with the step back up in trip a plus.

runners.breeder: E A R L Equi-Michel 6 & T Leboucher
runners.comment: One to watch in betting now up in trip on second chase start, but needs a step forward
runners.name: Lord De Vinci
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 8yo who is one to watch in the betting now up in trip on his second chase start; however, he didn't show enough over fences at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft) on New Year's Day to have compelling claims.

runners.comment: Rejuvenated 12yo; remains well treated on old form; major player if renaissance continues
runners.name: Uptown Harry
runners.spotlight: Rejuvenated 12yo who went close at Musselburgh (2m7f, soft) in December and comfortably went one better at Newcastle (2m7f, good to soft) last month; he's 8lb higher than last time but remains well treated on his old form and he's a two-time winner here; major player if renaissance continues.

runners.comment: Two wins at Cartmel last summer but he's struggled at Ayr/Catterick on last two starts
runners.name: Judicial Review
runners.spotlight: Two wins at Cartmel last summer (3m1f/2m5f, good to soft/good); however, pulled up/well beaten at Ayr and Catterick on his last two starts and a big turnaround is necessary today.

runners.comment: Just 9-2 for recent chase debut at Sedgefield but well beaten; a tongue-tie goes on
runners.name: Carrhill
runners.spotlight: Point runner-up (seven attempts in that sphere); lightly raced under rules and sent off just 9-2 for recent chase debut at Sedgefield (3m2f, good to soft); however, he was well beaten and needs to be an entirely different proposition in a first-time tongue-tie here.

runners.comment: Runner-up in first-time cheekpieces (retained) at Ayr and he's on the shortlist
runners.name: Rob Roy Macgregor
runners.spotlight: 0-14 since winning a bumper here on debut in March 2023; 0-4 over fences but he ran well when runner-up at Ayr (3m, heavy) three weeks ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained); he's on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Inconsistent and pulled up last time but 2nd in this last year and not ruled out each-way
runners.name: Gibberwell
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent 10yo who has won just two of his 26 chase starts and was pulled up at Uttoxeter last time; however, he twice ran well here last winter, including when second in this race, and is not ruled out each-way.

runners.comment: Not running badly at end of 2025 but pulled up last month and now 0-12 under rules
runners.name: Joie More
runners.spotlight: Didn't run badly on final two starts in 2025 and continues to drop down the weights; however, pulled up at Ayr last month and now 0-12 under rules; needs to bounce back in a big way in a first-time tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Third at Sedgefield in December then didn't run badly in a higher grade at Ayr
runners.name: Cave Hill
runners.spotlight: Stayed on for 2l third of seven in first-time cheekpieces at Sedgefield (2m5f, soft) in December and didn't run badly in a higher grade than this at Ayr (3m, soft) last month; each-way possibilities now back into a Class 5 with a first-time visor replacing the cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Not devoid of promise at Ayr but ran in snatches when well beaten at Catterick
runners.name: Whispering Dancer
runners.spotlight: Not devoid of promise when fifth from 15lb out of the handicap at Ayr last month on second chase start; however, a lesser run followed at Catterick, where he ran in snatches; 3lb wrong today; has to raise his game.

16:34.race_name: Next Raceday 16th February "Junior" National Hunt Flat Race (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Home-bred son of Jack Hobbs; brother to a 2m hurdle winner; interesting
runners.name: Barracilla
runners.spotlight: Home-bred son of Jack Hobbs; brother to a 2m hurdle winner; stable has a decent record in bumpers; interesting.

runners.comment: £34,000 3yo by Vadamos; half-brother to to 2m/2m1f hurdle winner; worth a market check
runners.name: Irish Goodbye
runners.spotlight: £34,000 3yo by Vadamos; half-brother to to 2m/2m1f hurdle winner out of a point winner; worth a market check on debut.

runners.comment: 30,000gns yearling by The Grey Gatsby; dam a dirt winner; conditions not sure to suit
runners.name: Jimmy Gatz
runners.spotlight: By The Grey Gatsby; bought for 30,000gns as a yearling and is out of mare who won over 8.5f on dirt in USA; conditions not sure to suit.

runners.comment: Tailed off in a juvenile hurdle last time having shaped well when fourth on bumper debut
runners.name: Marvel Magic
runners.spotlight: Fair debut when fourth to a stable companion at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) but tailed off last of six when tried over hurdles last time at Haydock (1m7f, good); may do better back in a bumper.

runners.comment: 75,000euros 3yo by Masked Marvel; half-brother to two Flat/hurdle winners; a possible
runners.name: Masked Blagny
runners.spotlight: By Masked Marvel; bought for 75,000euros as a 3yo; half-brother to two Flat/hurdle winners; interesting.

runners.comment: 7-1 when 12l fourth to a subsequent winner at Wetherby on debut; should improve
runners.name: Masterfield
runners.spotlight: French-bred; 7-1 when 12l fourth to a subsequent winner in a Wetherby bumper on debut; should improve on that.

runners.comment: Dam half-sister to Irish Grand National winner; quite interesting but may need further
runners.name: Success Story
runners.spotlight: 38,000euros foal; fourth foal of a 2m5f hurdle winner who is a half-sister to Irish Grand National winner; quite interesting on debut but may need further in time.

17:30.race_name: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Handicap

runners.comment: Two C&D wins from his last four starts; no surprise to see another prominent showing
runners.name: Harbour Vision
runners.spotlight: Consistency is not this veteran's strong suit but he has won two of his last four starts, both over C&D, and last week's was by 2l; 4lb penalty to overcome but no surprise to see him go well.

runners.comment: Chasing hat-trick and only 3lb higher than for last week's ready C&D win; the one to beat
runners.name: Hows The Guvnor
runners.spotlight: Chasing a hat-trick after wins over 1m at Southwell and C&D in the last fortnight; only 3lb higher than for the last week's success, which was a comfortable one, and he looks the one to beat.

runners.comment: Struggled in three runs since a Lingfield win (7f) in November; others look safer
runners.name: Ten Club
runners.spotlight: Came from off the pace to win a 7f handicap at Lingfield in November; well beaten in his three runs since and has more to prove than some of these.

runners.comment: Had a productive January; poorly positioned when third last time; high on the list
runners.name: Secret Road
runners.spotlight: Had a good January, winning twice and in the frame on another four occasions; poorly positioned in a steadily run race at Lingfield ten days ago and still looked in top form; high on the list.

runners.comment: String of good efforts since September and likely to be in the thick of it once again
runners.name: Bomb Squad
runners.spotlight: Missed out by a nose at Southwell off this mark in December; held his form since and is likely to be in the thick of things once again.

runners.comment: Recent AW efforts don't point to him being the answer today
runners.name: Romanovich
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould
runners.spotlight: Course winner; two 7f wins at Chepstow last year; AW runs this winter don't point to him being the answer today.

runners.comment: Smooth C&D win in December was followed by two lesser efforts; needs a return to his best
runners.name: Havana Club
runners.spotlight: Smooth win over C&D in December but he was below that level next time (6f) and ran poorly behind Harbour Vision 45 days ago; needs a return to his best.

runners.comment: Four wins in early 2025; penultimate start offered hope of a revival; slowly away latest
runners.name: Cloch Nua
runners.spotlight: Four wins in the early part of 2025 (7f and 1m); down to a handy mark again and his penultimate effort was a step back in the right direction; disappointed 12 days ago (slowly away) but a revival isn't out of the question.

runners.comment: Second at Lingfield in December but less good twice since; others come here in better form
runners.name: Roman Emperor
runners.spotlight: Second at Lingfield in December (7f) but his two runs since haven't been at the same level (had an excuse last time); others appeal more.

18:00.race_name: Midnite, Building The Future Of Betting Handicap

runners.breeder: Mrs M Leurson & Mrs C Head
runners.comment: Conditions suit and he should have a big run in him dropping into Class 4 company
runners.name: Coachello
runners.spotlight: Conditions suit and he ran well for third in a stronger race over C&D in late December; not so good at Newcastle two weeks ago but he's still a key player dropped into a Class 4.

runners.comment: Won at Southwell on stable debut; hamstrung by slow start latest; remains of interest
runners.name: Betsen
runners.spotlight: Sprung a 40-1 surprise at Southwell on his stable debut in November; slowly away and couldn't land a blow at Newcastle two weeks ago; still of interest judged on the Southwell run.

runners.comment: On a winning mark and conditions suit; promising return to action five weeks ago; chance
runners.name: Many A Star
runners.spotlight: Four wins in 2025, including over C&D and off this mark; made a pleasing return from 142 days off when fourth over C&D five weeks ago; can take a step forward today.

runners.breeder: Mme Isabelle Mauger & Mr Guy Benachour
runners.comment: Not at his best on last two starts but might not face much pace pressure this time; chance
runners.name: Dyrholaey
runners.spotlight: Well short of his best on his last two starts but he is slipping down the weights and might not face much competition for the lead in this field; shouldn't be passed over lightly.

runners.comment: Well handicapped on best form; new yard likely to find the key to him at some point
runners.name: Cajetan
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent for Jack Channon but he is a three-time AW winner who has dropped to the same mark off which he demolished his rivals at Newcastle last winter; sold for 10,000gns last October; new trainer likely to find the key to him and he's one to note for market confidence back from 236 days off.

runners.comment: Absent since poor run on slow ground in October; not ruled out under suitable conditions
runners.name: Powdering
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly on soft ground at Pontefract when last seen 106 days ago; won't mind the return to Tapeta and she isn't on a bad mark on last year's best; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Two fair runs last month; back to his last winning mark; one to consider
runners.name: No Return
runners.spotlight: His two wins in Ireland (both 6f on good ground) came from the front; two fair runs on Polytrack last month and he is back to his last winning mark; could go well.

18:30.race_name: Create Your Bet Builders At Midnite Restricted Maiden Stakes (For Horses In Bands C/D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Well beaten in a 6f maiden and a 7f novice here this year; minor handicaps beckon
runners.name: Lucky Sevens
runners.spotlight: Well beaten in a 6f maiden and a 7f novice here this year; minor handicaps beckon.

runners.comment: Runner-up in sprint maidens at Newcastle on last two starts; should be involved again
runners.name: Harlequin Bay
runners.spotlight: Promising second at Newcastle in November (5f) and filled the same spot back there one month later (6f); should remain competitive.

runners.comment: Two promising efforts this winter, beaten a short head latest; leading claims
runners.name: Sparksmith
runners.spotlight: Promise at Lingfield on debut in December and built on it when collared close home at Chelmsford 26 days ago (both 6f); can do better and holds leading claims.

runners.comment: Finished last in both starts, including when well behind Lovethiswayagain ten days ago
runners.name: Analeesa
runners.spotlight: Big prices and hasn't beaten a rival in her two starts, including when the best part of 8l behind Lovethiswayagain at Lingfield ten days ago.

runners.comment: Runner-up in two of her five starts; should be in the thick of it once again
runners.name: Lovethiswayagain
runners.owner: Mrs Paul Shanahan & Mrs M V Magnier
runners.spotlight: Ran as well as she ever has when second to a hot favourite at Lingfield ten days ago (6f); likely to make another bold bid.

runners.comment: Last of nine on last month's Chelmsford debut (6f); may do better over longer trips
runners.name: Nautical Sky
runners.spotlight: 80-1 when last of nine on her Chelmsford debut 26 days ago (6f); should do better in time but perhaps over further.

runners.comment: Some promise but ultimately well held on recent Kempton debut (7f); longer-term prospect
runners.name: Follow My Heart
runners.spotlight: 80-1, slowly away and ended up well beaten at Kempton last month (7f); that run offered hope of better but she's perhaps one for the longer term.

runners.comment: C&D winner; below best on last month's return to the Flat; others have stronger claims
runners.name: Parramount
runners.spotlight: Fit from hurdling when down the field at Chelmsford on last month's return to the Flat; C&D winner off a 5lb higher mark in November 2024; others have more pressing claims.

runners.breeder: Exors Of The Late Mrs L Peacock
runners.comment: Not at his best latest but dangerous mark on 2025 best; Rossa Ryan a positive booking
runners.name: One Cool Dreamer
runners.spotlight: Latest Kempton effort (1m4f) wasn't one of his best but he is on a feasible mark on last year's best; Rossa Ryan booked and a better effort should be forthcoming.

runners.comment: Followed Southwell win with a solid 3rd over C&D last week; should remain competitive
runners.name: Prince Quattro
runners.owner: Ursa Major Ltd & Hicky Parmar Racing
runners.spotlight: Gained his first Flat win when digging deep in a 1m6f handicap at Southwell 12 days ago; similar form when third over C&D last week; should remain competitive.

runners.comment: 0-9 but has shown promise and is on a lowly mark; new trip needs to revive her fortunes
runners.name: Word Of Mouth
runners.spotlight: Nine-race maiden; promise last summer and she's slipped in the weights but she will need to step up on this winter's two runs; up in trip.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Haras Du Cadran Et Al
runners.comment: Better run when heavily backed at Southwell 17 days ago (1m4f); should remain competitive
runners.name: Skycutter
runners.spotlight: Useful jumper; 25lb higher when joining this yard and, after five defeats at big prices, the money came for him at Southwell 17 days ago (1m4f); fared better in third on that occasion and he's handicapped to go well.

runners.comment: Latest fourth to Prince Quattro was promising; dangerous if he can build on it
runners.name: Further Measure
runners.spotlight: Shaped quite nicely from off the pace in a Southwell handicap won by Prince Quattro 12 days ago; dangerous if he can build on it.

runners.comment: Not beaten far into fifth over 2m here last month; others bring more persuasive claims
runners.name: Hill Station
runners.spotlight: Not beaten far into fifth in a 2m handicap here four weeks ago; on a fair mark but others bring more persuasive claims.

runners.comment: Off the mark at Chelmsford in December (1m6f); form franked and he makes most appeal
runners.name: Captain Robert
runners.spotlight: He had been threatening prior to his 1m6f win at Chelmsford in December; the second and third there have both won since and a 4lb rise shouldn't be beyond him; makes most appeal.

runners.comment: Has shown some promise for new stable and stepping back up in trip could help
runners.name: Maywedance
runners.spotlight: 1m4f win at Kempton on her final start for Alice Haynes in November; two runs for new yard haven't been as bad as the distance beaten might suggest; interesting stepping back up in trip.

runners.comment: 2nd over C&D last week (Prince Quattro a neck behind in 3rd); each-way shout again
runners.name: Billy Bathgate
runners.spotlight: Veteran who finished a neck in front of Prince Quattro over C&D last week; only 1lb higher than for his win here (2m) in December; considered once again.

19:30.race_name: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap

runners.comment: Two wide-margin wins here last month; still of major interest under latest 5lb penalty
runners.name: Eupator
runners.owner: Middleham Park Racing I and Partner
runners.spotlight: Got his act together in recent starts, going close at Lingfield last month (front two clear) before two easy wins here (8.6f and 9.5f); effectively up another 6lb in his hat-trick bid but he still looks ahead of the handicapper; obvious claims.

runners.breeder: S C E A Le Haras DHaspel
runners.comment: 0-5 for this yard but went close here in December (8.6f); favourite latest; e-w shout
runners.name: Shihoku
runners.spotlight: 0-5 for James Owen but he ran well for second over 8.6f here in December; not quite so good since, including when well backed at Kempton 13 days ago, but he's clearly thought to be well treated.

runners.comment: Improving 4yo but steps up in trip tonight and will need to settle better than last time
runners.name: Towerlands
runners.spotlight: Ended 2025 on the up, completing an AW hat-trick before coming up just shy in his bid for a four-timer; another solid effort at Kempton 13 days ago but he will need to settle better now stepping up in trip.

runners.comment: Arrives in good form but hopes appear to rest on the step up in trip giving him a boost
runners.name: Commander Of Life
runners.spotlight: Three wins in 2025, the latest at Chelmsford in October off 4lb lower (7f); two solid efforts in defeat over 7f last month; stamina for this trip has to be taken on trust.

runners.comment: Two-time C&D winner; comes here in good form but needs more to win in this field
runners.name: Charlies Choice
runners.spotlight: Two C&D wins on his record; ready win at Lingfield last month (1m4f) and his two subsequent efforts were respectable; should run his race once again.

runners.comment: C&D win last February; disappointed 12 days ago and needs to rebound quickly
runners.name: Urban Road
runners.owner: S McMillan F Reay & A D Brown
runners.spotlight: Completed an AW hat-trick last February, the third leg coming over C&D; 6lb higher today and he needs to bounce back from a modest effort at Newcastle 12 days ago.

runners.comment: Below his best 13 days ago and needs to prove his stamina; others look stronger
runners.name: Spirit Lead Me
runners.spotlight: Won two Class 6 events on AW in the space of four days last September (7f and 1m); not beaten far into fourth here (8.6f) in his hat-trick bid but below par two weeks ago; has to prove his stamina.

runners.comment: 3-3 this year, all over 6f on Tapeta; needs more back at 5f and under penalty but thriving
runners.name: Grey Horizon
runners.spotlight: Thriving for Scott Dixon this winter and he completed a hat-trick last month, winning at Southwell and twice here (all 6f); not sure he's well in under a 6lb penalty but he looks quick enough for 5f and  has the advantage of the inside stall; respected.

runners.comment: Easy Southwell win in September but failed to back it up one week later; absent since
runners.name: Rotokura Belle
runners.owner: Crazy Racing Ltd & Miss D Francis
runners.spotlight: Easily saw off her eight rivals in a 5f nursery at Southwell in September; well short of that level at Newcastle one week later (6f); needs further progress to defy this mark, back from a four-month break.

runners.comment: Solid record since switched to AW; can't afford to fluff the start dropped back to 5f
runners.name: Flash Rascal
runners.spotlight: Strong finish when winning a 6f nursery at Chelmsford on his AW debut in November (strong form);  third in his three runs since and not handicapped out of things but he can get it wrong at the stalls and that is a worry back at 5f.

runners.comment: No improvement for handicapping here last week (6f); drawn widest back at 5f
runners.name: Whizzy Dizzy
runners.spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps when fourth of six over 6f here last week; drop back to 5f can help but she is drawn widest and needs a surge of improvement.

runners.comment: Needs to step forward from last month's stable debut but that is possible back down to 5f
runners.name: Love Alive
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise for Richard Hannon last summer; dropped away over 6f at Southwell on her stable debut three weeks ago but has been dropped 3lb and could have a bigger effort in her back at 5f.

runners.comment: Good 2nd on nursery debut (6f) in December; drops in trip for stable debut
runners.name: Wisetanck
runners.spotlight: Went close on his handicap debut at Kempton in December (6f); subsequent third at Southwell came in a Class 4 and this should be more manageable; new stable (same owner) quick to drop him in trip.

runners.comment: Not at his best here last week (6f); return to 5f and new headgear could give him a lift
runners.name: Moretons
runners.spotlight: Chased home Mwaki over C&D in October; failed to back it up over 6f here last week and blinkers are now given a go (tongue-tie worn on last three runs is dispensed with); one to consider.

runners.comment: Bolted up over 5f at Lingfield 13 days ago; 10lb rise asks a stiffer question of him
runners.name: Far Too Fizzy
runners.spotlight: Twice a winner in AW handicaps, latterly when storming clear in a 5f event at Lingfield two weeks ago; a 10lb rise asks more of him though and he is held by Grey Horizon on their 6f run here three weeks ago.

runners.comment: Won from Moretons over C&D last October; ran poorly when last seen, but better than that
runners.name: Mwaki
runners.spotlight: Led late on when getting the better of Moretons for C&D win last October; ran no sort of race at Lingfield when last seen ten weeks ago but he's better than that and can't be discounted.

20:30.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap

runners.comment: Reliable in Class 6 handicaps; fairly exposed but should give her running
runners.name: Popty Ping
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at the tenth attempt when leading late on in a 7f nursery at Southwell in December; not quite so good twice since but this is a welcome drop back in class.

runners.comment: Unexposed handicap debutant; visor is enlisted this evening; capable of better
runners.name: Silver State
runners.spotlight: Modest form in three maiden/novice runs at up to 1m; faces a more realistic assignment on this handicap debut and the addition of a visor could help too.

runners.comment: Two AW wins this winter, including C&D; disappointing on last two starts; needs a revival
runners.name: Thanh Nam
runners.spotlight: Won a 1m nursery at Chelmsford in November and followed up over C&D the following month; last two starts have been disappointing and he needs a full revival.

runners.comment: Hit with 10lb rise for his 3rd over 7f here on December's stable debut; longer trip a plus
runners.name: Telling Time
runners.spotlight: Good third here (7f) on his stable debut in December and stepping up in trip seems likely to suit; hit with a 10lb rise for that effort though and he will need to progress now handicapping.

runners.comment: Didn't see things out in three 7f runs at two; bred to be better than this and may improve
runners.name: Bergamo Gold
runners.spotlight: Didn't see things out in three 7f runs as a 2yo; steps up in trip for her handicap debut and could still have more to offer.

runners.comment: Potential improver now upped in trip and fitted with cheekpieces for his handicap debut
runners.name: Hamish Leek
runners.spotlight: Modest form in three 7f runs on AW in late 2025; opening mark is not a gift on that evidence but he is bred to be better than this level and headgear is added for his handicap debut.

runners.comment: 0-9 for Alice Haynes but did show some promise; not ruled out on her stable debut
runners.name: Lexington Express
runners.spotlight: Failed to win in nine starts for Alice Haynes at up to 1m2f; starts out for a new stable off a reduced mark and she's one to consider back from a three-month break.

runners.comment: Best form at 7f; stamina query at this trip and connections now turn to cheekpieces
runners.name: Flying Macs
runners.spotlight: Her two best efforts came over 7f and she is still to convince over 1m; cheekpieces added for first time; others appeal more for win purposes.

runners.comment: Promising handicap debut in November but two heavy defeats have followed; risky
runners.name: Akrivos
runners.spotlight: Promising third behind Thanh Nam at Chelmsford on handicap debut in November (1m) but suffered heavy defeats twice since; has a point to prove now.

runners.breeder: Moyns Park Estate And Stud Ltd
runners.comment: Poor form at up to 7f but he is a potential big improver upped in trip for handicap debut
runners.name: Montu
runners.spotlight: Poor form in three maiden/novice runs at up to 7f and not obviously well treated on that evidence; he is bred to be a fair bit better than this though and stepping up in trip looks sure to suit; could take a big step forward.

runners.comment: Better effort over 6f two weeks ago; declared 8.00 Wolverhampton Monday
runners.name: Exhibition Match
runners.spotlight: BHA rated 30 after her first three starts; appeared to take a big step forward when fourth over 6f here two weeks ago, a run that saw her mark raised 20lb; declared 8.00 Wolverhampton Monday.

runners.comment: No better for handicapping when 6th of 9 here (6f) last week; new trip needs to transform
runners.name: Curated
runners.spotlight: No improvement for the switch to handicaps when sixth of nine over 6f here last week; this longer trip needs to have a significant effect.
